review.why: Build and fix interfaces with shadcn/ui: use the project's real config, add and compose components, and follow the rules that keep code correct.
review.summary: The official shadcn/ui skill. It reads the project's configuration, enforces rules with incorrect and correct code pairs (styling, forms, composition, icons, chat components), explains the CLI workflow (search, docs, add with dry-run and diff, presets), and covers turning a DESIGN.md into a themed design system. Rule files and a coverage script are included.
strengths: Grounded in the actual project: aliases, Tailwind version, base library, icon library and framework are read before advising.
Clear, checkable rules (FieldGroup with Field for forms, semantic colors, gap instead of space-y) with incorrect and correct examples.
Safe update workflow: dry-run and diff first, never overwrite without approval, and an explicit registry rather than a guessed one.
cautions: At load time it runs npx shadcn@latest info --json to inject the project context, and later commands fetch the latest CLI each time.

SKILL.md, the forms and composition rules and the coverage script were read in full; the other reference files (CLI, registry, design system, chat, about 100 KB) and the showcase assets were only searched for risky calls, not read line by line.
Tied to the shadcn CLI and its current component set; it is marked as not user-invocable, so it loads automatically.
